name: branding-violet-hexagon-z-monogram-zuva-brand-board
title: Violet Hexagon Z Monogram Brand Board
whatItIs: A lilac-framed bento board of rounded tiles: a black tile with a violet wordmark on a hexagon pattern, a violet tile with a white Z inside a hexagon, a Syne Bold specimen, a phone corner with the gradient app icon among system icons, two mannequins in black and violet tees and a wide violet tile with the mark and wordmark in white.
whatItMeans: A single violet with black and a hexagon motif repeated across pattern, mark and icon gives an instantly recognisable set.
techniques: Hexagon pattern reused as texture and shape
Big Aa specimen with the typeface name
App icon shown among system icons
Tees showing the mark small on the chest

vocabulary.definition: Reusing one shape across all brand assets.
A logo built from a single letter.
An app icon displayed beside real system icons.
